requirements.title: Smart-Select -> Classify -> Contextual Edit
requirements.description: A SAM-backed segment op + region classification feed a canvas selection tool that snaps to an object silhouette, classifies the selected region, and offers a context-specific edit menu that compiles to an inpaint / instruction-edit {mask + prompt}. Keyboard and file-upload fallbacks are preserved so no operation is pointer-only.

validation.notes: Planned (not yet implemented; automated test pending): SAM mask generation; region classification maps to an edit-affordance set
Planned (not yet implemented; automated test pending): select -> classify -> contextual edit compiles to an inpaint/instruction-edit request; keyboard/file fallback covered
